spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the lifecycle CSSOM implies for a nullable styleSheet: null while pending, the real sheet when loaded, and null (spec) vs phantom empty sheet (legacy) after a genuine failed fetch.

interactive.rationale: Three run buttons insert real imports and produce a millisecond-stamped timeline of live reads plus a parallel fetch() of the same URL showing the true HTTP status.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises synchronous first reads, settling transitions, and a loaded-vs-404 comparison; the timeline records exactly those events.

edge_cases.rationale: Pending synchronous read, loaded transition, genuine 404 failure with phantom-sheet detection, run-token cancellation so re-runs never interleave stale timers.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5123480866783232 and the CSSOM styleSheet attribute section.

conformance.rationale: The suite pins the same contracts without page-load 404 noise by using a text/plain (HTTP 200) failed-sheet probe; the page's deliberate 404 is click-triggered only. 141 honestly fails the failed-import-null assertion, matching the timeline's phantom verdict.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP driver: race-them run produced pending null reads, 200 settling to a 3-rule sheet, 404 settling to a phantom 0-rule sheet, verdict and branch asserts correct; the only console/network entries are the two deliberate, in-page-explained 404s of the failure subject. Partial: the 158 null-after-failure path is pinned by conformance, not observable on 141.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts every tracked run settles and records the phantom-vs-null branch explicitly; deliberate 404s are the demo's subject, click-triggered, and labelled in the timeline with the parallel fetch status.

design_system.rationale: Timeline, verdict and buttons use the shared tokens; rose/emerald readings sit on paper; dark buttons set color explicitly.

accessibility.rationale: Timeline is a labelled ol with text rows, verdict is text (not colour-only — wording carries the state), single polite output announces run completion, all controls native buttons.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Grid timeline rows wrap via overflow-wrap:anywhere; harness shows 0px overflow and clean-on-load console at 360×740 and 1280×800 (the 404 rows appear only after a click, which the load-only harness never triggers).

openQuestions.title: Capture the null-forever failure timeline on Chrome 158
openQuestions.detail: On 141 the 404 run flips null → phantom empty sheet at load-failure time. On a 158 build the timeline should show the value staying null for the full 3 s window with the verdict going modern; verify and note the timing.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates async results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Single polite region per surface; do not announce interstitial 'running' noise repeatedly; final results are what matter.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Timeline rows append silently (they are passive text); only the run-complete summary goes through the aria-live=polite output, so screen-reader users get one meaningful announcement per run.

guidanceConsulted.query: timestamped log list layout that wraps on narrow screens
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Two-column grid with a fixed-width time gutter and a wrapping content column (minmax + overflow-wrap).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Timeline rows are grid-template-columns: 5.5rem 1fr with overflow-wrap:anywhere on the content span; verified no overflow at 360px.

summary: Lifecycle timeline for the nullable styleSheet: pending null, loaded sheet, and 141's phantom empty sheet after a real 404, each read live and timestamped with the parallel HTTP status on record. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium-141 CDP driver (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this container); console/network clean apart from the deliberate, labelled 404 subject.
